QF.id: AIFM CII Investment Process and Governance_20

question.text: 'Chambal Seed Category I AIF' is investing in a pre-revenue deep-tech start-up and chooses to link the valuation to specific technical and commercial targets rather than future forecast. This technique is called:

explanation.text: The Logic: Milestone valuation pegs valuation (and staged funding) to specified technical/commercial milestones in the business plan. Failure to meet a milestone may trigger a downward revision or a 'down round', not automatic withdrawal of funding. The Trap: Weighted average is an anti-dilution method. DCF and book-value are standalone valuation methods but don't 'peg' valuation to milestones. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C covers milestone valuation. XV (Research Analyst) tests DCF/book-value but not milestone valuation for private markets.
